note: Both sets extract the same layup materials and the CG/GC/NA/SC marker data from Figure 2-6, but B captures more of the marker coordinates (NA x2 and SC x2 in addition to the x3 values) while A states the NA, CG and GC x3 coordinates twice with contradictory values (0.05/0.1 m versus 0.0 m). remarks: Marker coordinates are only legible to roughly ±0.05 m from the plot, so exact values could not be fully verified; the non-zero x3 readings (NA 0.05, CG 0.1, GC 0.05) are consistent with the markers sitting slightly above the x3 = 0 line and are corroborated across both sets, so A's 0.0 m restatements were treated as the misreads. The condition strings "Section : 0.7" and "cross section at 70% span" denote the same section and were judged as one fact, which is why each set's material/coordinate repetitions count as duplicates. Both sets miss Figure 2-5 (lofted blade shape) and neither records the x2/x3 axis units beyond the values themselves.
